unlisted_practices: Schema-enforced recursive synthesis with validated knowledge state for long-context clinical documents
Deterministic provenance tracking of extracted entities to source text offsets
Synonym consolidation layer (nomenclature resilience) for entity extraction

screen.reason: Evaluates a novel recursive synthesis framework (C-RLM) against a baseline RAG model on complex clinical case reports. Although it emphasizes auditability and provenance, the evaluation is a model architecture benchmark rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
